Breaking news: U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham has died at the age of 71 after what his office described as a "brief and sudden illness." The announcement marks the end of more than two decades of Senate service and is expected to have significant implications for South Carolina representation and the U.S. Senate. 
In this video, we review the official announcement from Senator Graham's office, examine his political career, discuss his role in recent national and foreign policy debates, and explain what happens next under South Carolina law regarding the Senate seat. We also look at reactions from political leaders and the immediate impact of his passing on Congress.
